bug_found_and_fixed.name: imagination middleware never actually injected
bug_found_and_fixed.severity: high — feature was orphaned, no test caught it
bug_found_and_fixed.root_cause: imagination.py line 170 called append_to_system_message(request, body); the helper expects a SystemMessage and silently raised AttributeError because ModelRequest has no .content_blocks. The except: clause in _maybe_inject swallowed the exception, so the failure was invisible — _should_inject returned True, the snapshot counter never incremented, the system prompt was never mutated.
bug_found_and_fixed.regression_test_added: TestImaginationGating::test_injection_reaches_request_system_message — drives the full _maybe_inject path and asserts the injection header lands in the request's system_message
bug_found_and_fixed.why_phase_1_missed_this: Phase 1 marked imagination 'sings' but only verified the gating logic (_should_inject) and the imagination-trait bump path. The actual injection path (_maybe_inject calling append_to_system_message) was never exercised by a test.

pass_3_error_response.name: error response does not bump helped counter

pass_4_live_ab.name: control vs treatment with real Haiku 4.5
pass_4_live_ab.prompt: I keep getting 'permission denied' on the same chmod step. I've tried sudo, I've tried checking the file owner, I've tried different paths. I'm stuck. What approach should I try next?

control.first_sentence: Try checking if the file system itself is mounted read-only (mount | grep ro) or if SELinux/AppArmor policies are blocking the operation...

treatment.first_sentence: Step back from the file itself: check if the *directory* containing it is readable/traversable (you need `x` permission on parent dirs to access anything inside them)...

pass_4_live_ab.qualitative_difference: treatment's framing shifted — it opens with 'step back from the file itself' (a meta-move) and emphasizes the directory hierarchy rather than diving straight into mount flags. Suggests the dream-imagery 'see the shape differently' framing influenced the response without leaking literal dream vocabulary.
pass_4_live_ab.result: PASS — treatment diverges from control without parroting dream content
